Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Energy Marketing Coordinator position at Eastpak. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content strategy, combined with a deep passion for youth culture, fashion, and music, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Eastpak's cultural relevance and brand elevation.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills in project management, stakeholder coordination, and integrated campaign execution. I have successfully managed on-page SEO, content creation, and website development for various clients, ensuring seamless delivery and measurable results. My experience with social media integration and performance tracking aligns well with the role's focus on maximizing collaboration impact across channels.

I am particularly drawn to Eastpak's commitment to culture-led storytelling and partnerships. My own project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to build a brand from scratch, implement structured data for AI search visibility, and create compelling narratives that resonate with audiences. I thrive in collaborative environments and am eager to bring my proactive mindset and cultural insights to the team.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and passion can contribute to Eastpak's success. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Energy Marketing Coordinator position at Eastpak. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in SEO, content, and web development, and a genuine passion for youth culture, fashion, and music, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Eastpak's cultural relevance and brand elevation.

In my current role at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in brand marketing and project coordination. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. This role has taught me to juggle multiple projects, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and deliver results on tight deadlines. I am comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, which I use to track performance and guide decisions.

What draws me to Eastpak is its commitment to culture-led storytelling and partnerships. I have always been fascinated by how brands connect with youth culture through music, art, and sports. My own project, mirook.com, allowed me to apply this interest: I designed and built a website for a young chess champion, implementing structured data and AI search optimization to enhance visibility. This experience taught me the importance of authentic narratives and integrated activation across channels.

I am a proactive, collaborative team player who thrives in international environments. Having worked remotely with clients across Belgium and Turkey, I am comfortable bridging cultural and communication gaps. My Dutch is at B1 level and I am actively improving it, which will help me integrate into the Antwerp team.

I am eager to bring my skills in content creation, project management, and cultural insights to Eastpak. I would love the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your collaborations and partnerships. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
